experiment: Expanded and memory context harness smoke
harness_corrections: Query variants are objects with text, not strings.
Observer key expansion uses note_keys: merge and exactly quoted synthetic observer records; the unused key_expansion request did not exercise it.
Structured memory records omit bodies; verify the exact delivered text in Markdown with matching metadata and revision.

query_cache_only_copy_smoke.scope: Fixture preparation only; no runtime behavior change or performance claim.
query_cache_only_copy_smoke.store_copy: SQLite and all query caches preserved; only gf-cache/<project>/{resolution,sources,sources.lock} omitted; no graph build is measured

result_data.limitations: One synthetic Python code corpus, three reviewed notes, and three directly seeded observer records with exact source quotes. Observer record authoring and invalidation are not exercised. Measures feature costs, not an A/B optimization. Does not qualify a large memory catalogue, note-only query recall, or independent user-question recall.
result_data.method: Fresh CLI processes measured with fresh workers; warm OS cache; one warmup per workload/probe; alternating workload order; exact repeated packets, citation bytes, labelled source, reviewed notes and budgets checked; caller/callee citation spans independently checked against Python AST declarations
